text: Academic Mode Switch 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的学术模式开关，在输入框旁加入控制按钮，并将学术身份和核查纪律挂入系统提示。开启后，它要求进行多来源研究、来源真实性三遍核查、逻辑三遍检查和交付自检；同时把每个模型步骤的推理强度与输出预算提升到当前路由可用的最高水平。较长回复缺少核查记录时，会在回合结束前退回补充一次。适合需要审阅论文、核对引用或分析论证的用户；不需要 API 密钥或额外外部服务，开关状态保存在本机。

Academic Mode Switch adds a toggle beside the DSH web composer. When enabled, it adds academic guidance, maximizes reasoning and output limits, and returns long replies without a verification log for one revision. It supports citation review; state is saved locally.

Academic Mode Switch 的功能「学术提示纪律」：开启开关后，系统提示加入学术身份、资料查证步骤、逻辑检查和交付清单，指导模型按可追溯方式完成研究任务。
Academic Mode Switch 的功能「推理与输出预算」：开启后，插件读取当前模型路由声明的能力，并将推理档位和最大输出 token 调至可用上限。
Academic Mode Switch 的功能「交付核查闸门」：回合即将结束时，若较长回复没有核查记录，插件会退回一次并提示补充核查。
Academic Mode Switch 的功能「输入框开关」：用户点击 Web 输入框旁的学术按钮切换模式，界面显示启用状态和最近一次应用的模型参数。
Academic Mode Switch 使用前须知：启用状态会跨重启保存在用户主目录的 ~/.dsh/academic-switch.json，并对所有会话生效；不需要时应关闭开关。

dsh-academic-switch README · 学术模式 · Academic Mode：**让 AI 助手像审稿人一样工作。** 它给 AI 一套必须遵守的查证纪律：每个引用的来源核查三遍，每份交付检查三遍逻辑，最后附上一份写明“查了什么、怎么查的”的核查记录。

适用于 **Claude Code · Codex · Antigravity · DeepSeek Harness**。

dsh-academic-switch README · 为什么需要：AI 写论文、做文献综述，最危险的不是写得差，而是写得像真的：

- 引用的文献不存在，或者 DOI、卷期页码对不上；
- 引文是真的，但结论被悄悄改得更确定：“可能相关”变成了“证明导致”；
- 数字没算过，百分比和百分点混在一起；
- 全程没有任何迹象告诉你哪一步其实没查。

学术模式不让模型变得更聪明。它做的是把查证变成**强制步骤**，并且让没做的部分在交付里**看得见**。

dsh-academic-switch README · 它让 AI 怎么做：| 环节 | 做什么 | 能抓到什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **来源三遍核查** | 第一遍确认来源真实存在、元数据对得上；第二遍回到原文，核对数字和引语；第三遍找独立来源交叉验证，查撤稿 | 不存在的文献、引错的数字、已撤稿的研究 |
| **逻辑三遍检查** | 第一遍查论证结构；第二遍排查谬误并重新计算数字；第三遍以审稿人身份反驳自己 | 断裂的论证链、算错的统计量、经不起反驳的结论 |
| **多方面查资料** | 中英文检索词；至少三类来源；正反证据都查；追到原始出处 | 只看到一边、只引了二手转述 |
| **交付前自检** | 十项清单，结果写进核查记录 | 悄悄跳过的步骤 |
| **核查记录** | 交付时附上来源核查表，每一项都对应本次真实打开过的页面或运行过的命令 | 无法追溯的结论 |

三遍用的是三种不同的方法，不是把同一个检查重复三次：每种方法能发现另外两种发现不了的错误。完整规则见 [`lib/prompt.js`](lib/prompt.js)，分八章。

dsh-academic-switch README · 交付物长什么样：> **问题**：GB/T 7714 参考文献著录规则，现在用哪一版？
>
> **结论**（置信度：中）：现行版是 GB/T 7714—2025，2025-12-02 发布，2026-07-01 起实施，取代 2015 版。
>
> ### 核查记录
>
> | 来源 | 第一遍 | 第二遍 | 第三遍 | 结论 |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | ① 全国标准信息公共服务平台 | 条目存在，状态“现行” | 两个日期与结论一致 | 官方一手来源 | 采用 |
> | ② readwonders.com 的指南 | 页面存在，属二手整理 | 日期与①一致 | 自称依据①，不独立 | 仅作旁证 |
>
> **来源说明**：① std.samr.gov.cn 的标准查询结果，2026-11-01 打开：GB/T 7714-2025《信息与文献 参考文献著录规则》，推荐性，发布日期 2025-12-02，实施日期 2026-07-01，状态“现行”；GB/T 7714-2015 状态为“废止”。② 页面末尾的来源列表把①列为依据。
>
> **检索词**：GB/T 7714 2025；参考文献著录规则 现行；实施日期。
>
> **局限**：只有一个独立的一手来源（官方平台），所以置信度是“中”而不是“高”；没有读到标准正文。
>
> **自检**：10/10 通过（第 3 项以“单一来源”标注）。

Antigravity 有两种装法。**自定义智能体**更接近“模式”：选中它，整场对话都按学术纪律走，不靠模型自己判断要不要载入。它出现在输入框下方的“Main Agent”下拉里，也出现在“Customizations”页的 Custom Agents 一栏。 智能体就是一个 Markdown 文件，仓库里是 [`antigravity/agents/academic-mode.md`](antigravity/agents/academic-mode.md)。`skills` 工具只装技能、不装智能体，所以需要复制文件。 PowerShell，装成全局（所有项目可用）：

dsh-academic-switch README · 常见问题：**它能保证 AI 不编造文献吗？**
不能，也没有任何提示词能保证。它做的是三件事：把查证写成强制步骤；要求每个结论标明来源和置信度；要求没查到的部分写成“未核实”。结果是造假更难，漏查更容易被你发现。引用仍然要你自己抽查。

**交付前核查闸门会判断核查记录是否属实吗？**
不会。它只检查长回复里有没有“核查记录”这一节，没有就退回补一次。内容真不真，要靠你读核查记录里的来源去验证。

**效果有评测吗？**
还没有系统评测。已经验证的是安装和加载：Claude Code 2.1.312 和 Codex 0.165.0 用本页的命令实际装上了；Antigravity 44.5.1 的技能与智能体加载器识别并正确解析了文件。模型在对话里按这套纪律做到什么程度，取决于你用的模型，这部分没有测。欢迎在 Issues 里贴出它没做到的地方。

**会让回复变长、变慢、更费 token 吗？**
会。每次请求多带约 4,500 个字符的提示词，推理更久，回复多一份核查记录。这是用时间和用量换可核查性。简单问答不需要用它。

dsh-academic-switch README · 常见问题：**它安全吗？**
技能和智能体都只是 Markdown 文本，不运行任何代码，也不申请额外权限。DeepSeek Harness 版是真正运行的插件，状态接口只接受本机回环地址的同源请求，源码都在 `lib/` 里，不长。

**规则是中文的，英文问题能用吗？**
规则里写明了“用用户提问的语言交付”。规则本身目前只有中文版，欢迎提交英文翻译。

dsh-academic-switch README · Academic Mode：**Make your AI assistant work like a peer reviewer.** It gives the AI a verification discipline it has to follow: every cited source is checked three times, every deliverable gets three logic reviews, and the answer ends with a log of what was checked and how.

For **Claude Code · Codex · Antigravity · DeepSeek Harness**.
dsh-academic-switch README · Why：Academic Mode does not make the model smarter. It turns verification into a **required step**, and makes whatever was skipped **visible** in the deliverable.

dsh-academic-switch README · What it makes the AI do：| Step | What | What it catches |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Three-pass source check** | Pass 1: the source exists and its metadata matches. Pass 2: go back to the text and check numbers and quotes. Pass 3: cross-check with an independent source and look for retractions | Invented papers, misquoted numbers, retracted studies |
| **Three-pass logic review** | Pass 1: the argument's structure. Pass 2: common fallacies, and recompute the numbers. Pass 3: argue against itself as a reviewer would | Broken reasoning chains, wrong statistics, conclusions that do not survive a challenge |
| **Multi-angle research** | Chinese and English search terms; at least three kinds of source; evidence for and against; trace claims to the original | One-sided evidence, reliance on second-hand summaries |
| **Pre-delivery checklist** | Ten items, with the result written into the log | Quietly skipped steps |
| **Verification log** | Attached to the answer; every line maps to a page that was actually opened or a command that was actually run | Conclusions you cannot trace |

text: dsh-academic-switch README · What a deliverable looks like：This is a **format example** of a verification log. The content comes from a real check made while building this project and was written up by hand. It is not model output.

dsh-academic-switch README · What a deliverable looks like：> **Question**: Which edition of GB/T 7714 (China's reference-list standard) is current?
>
> **Conclusion** (confidence: medium): GB/T 7714—2025 is current. Published 2025-12-02, in force from 2026-07-01, it replaces the 2015 edition.
>
> ### Verification log
>
> | Source | Pass 1 | Pass 2 | Pass 3 | Verdict |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | ① Official standards platform | Entry exists, status "current" | Both dates match the conclusion | Official primary source | Used |
> | ② readwonders.com guide | Page exists; secondary | Dates match ① | Says it relies on ①, so not independent | Corroboration only |
>
> **Source notes**: ① std.samr.gov.cn (National Public Service Platform for Standards Information), query result opened 2026-11-01: GB/T 7714-2025 "Information and documentation: rules for bibliographic references", recommended standard, issued 2025-12-02, in force 2026-07-01, status "current"; GB/T 7714-2015 is marked "abolished". ② The page's own source list names ① as its basis.
>
> **Search terms**: GB/T 7714 2025; reference rules current edition; effective date.
>
> **Limits**: only one independent primary source

dsh-academic-switch README · What a deliverable looks like：Look at the last two lines. It does not pretend to have checked everything. It says there is one independent source and that the standard's text was not read, and it lowers its confidence accordingly. That is the behaviour this discipline is after.

dsh-academic-switch README · FAQ：**Does it guarantee the AI will not invent references?**
No, and no prompt can. It does three things: it makes verification a required step, it asks for a source and a confidence level on every conclusion, and it asks that anything not found be written as "unverified". The result is that fabrication is harder and gaps are easier for you to see. You should still spot-check the citations.

dsh-academic-switch README · FAQ：**Does the pre-delivery gate judge whether the verification log is true?**
No. It only checks that a long answer contains a "Verification log" section and sends the answer back once if it does not. Whether the log is true is for you to check against the sources it lists.

dsh-academic-switch README · FAQ：**Has it been evaluated?**
Not systematically yet. What has been verified is installation and loading: Claude Code 2.1.312 and Codex 0.165.0 installed it with the commands on this page, and the skill and agent loader of Antigravity 44.5.1 recognised and parsed the files. How closely a model follows the discipline in a real conversation depends on the model, and that part is untested. Please open an issue with examples where it fell short.

dsh-academic-switch README · FAQ：**Does it make answers longer, slower and more expensive?**
Yes. Each request carries about 4,500 extra characters of instructions, the model reasons longer, and every answer gains a log. You are trading time and usage for verifiability. Simple questions do not need it.

dsh-academic-switch README · FAQ：**Is it safe?**
The skill and the agent are plain Markdown. They run no code and request no extra permissions. The DeepSeek Harness version is a real plugin; its state endpoint only accepts same-origin requests from the loopback address, and the source in `lib/` is short.

dsh-academic-switch README · FAQ：**The rules are in Chinese. Does it work for English questions?**
The rules tell the model to answer in the language you ask in. The rules themselves exist only in Chinese for now; an English translation would be a welcome contribution.
